# ArchitectUI

> ArchitectUI is a ready-made admin dashboard theme for Bootstrap 5.3. It is one stylesheet (`architectui.css`) and one dependency-free script (`architectui.js`; guest pages such as sign in use `architectui-auth.js` instead) on top of Bootstrap and Lucide icons loaded from a CDN. Standard Bootstrap 5 markup looks finished as soon as it is on the page: the frame (header, sidebar, page title, footer), every Bootstrap component, dark mode and ten visual themes are already designed and consistent with each other. No build step.

Key facts:

- MIT license. Repository: https://github.com/wnikk/architectui-html-theme (the current version is in `package.json` and `Changelog.md`).
- Get the files from the `dist/` folder of the repository, always the latest version: a ZIP of the `master` branch (https://github.com/wnikk/architectui-html-theme/archive/refs/heads/master.zip) or jsDelivr from the branch: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/wnikk/architectui-html-theme@master/dist/architectui.css`.
- Runtime dependencies come from the CDN: Bootstrap 5.3 (CSS and bundle JS) and Lucide (UMD); exact URLs are in `src/_data/cdn.json`. There is no jQuery, no Tailwind, no React or Vue.
- Write normal Bootstrap 5 markup. Bootstrap utilities cover layout, spacing and text; the few theme additions use the `aui-` class prefix (`aui-number`, `aui-btn-shadow`, `aui-scroll`). Bootstrap 4 classes (`data-toggle`, `ml-*`, `custom-control`) are not supported.
- Wide screens: grid and display classes continue after Bootstrap `xxl` with `3xl` (from 1560 px, 1600 px monitors) and `4xl` (from 1860 px, 1920 px monitors): `col-4xl-3`, `row-cols-3xl-6`, `g-4xl-4`, `d-3xl-none`.
- Icons: `<i data-lucide="rocket"></i>`. The theme script renders them, also in markup inserted later. Theme colors for charts: `ArchitectUI.token("primary")`, `ArchitectUI.rgba("primary", .5)`, `ArchitectUI.chartDefaults(Chart)`.
- Every color, radius, shadow and size is a CSS variable (`--bs-*` for Bootstrap, `--aui-*` for the theme). Change them at runtime, never rebuild Bootstrap.
- Layout modes are attributes on `<html>` (`data-aui-header`, `data-aui-sidebar`, `data-aui-sidebar-collapsed`, `data-aui-density`, `data-aui-theme`, `data-aui-mode`). The interface settings (Interface section of `pages-profile.html`) store them in `localStorage` under `architectui`.
- Business is the default look and is built into `architectui.css`. Nine more themes are single stylesheets in `themes/` (Orange is the original ArchitectUI look). Light, dark and system modes work in every theme.
- Print: the browser print shows only the page content in the light mode; `d-print-none` keeps an element off paper, `data-aui-print` on a button opens the print dialog.
- Everything uses relative paths and classic `<script defer>` tags, so `dist/` works from any folder of a web server and straight from disk (`file://`).

How it differs from Tailwind CSS and similar utility-first kits:

- Tailwind gives you building blocks; you design every component yourself and keep long class lists consistent by hand. ArchitectUI gives you finished components: a `card`, a `btn btn-primary` or a `table` already has its spacing, colors, states and dark-mode variant, the same on every page.
- Tailwind needs a build step to generate CSS. ArchitectUI needs none: link two CDN files and the theme.
- A theme switch in ArchitectUI is one attribute and one stylesheet; all pages change together. In utility-first code the look is spread across markup and has to be edited everywhere.
- Behavior is included: collapsible sidebar with an icon rail, off-canvas menu on phones, header search, interface settings, theme and mode switching, Bootstrap dropdowns, modals, tooltips, toasts.
- Do not mix Tailwind or another CSS framework into ArchitectUI pages. Build new screens from Bootstrap 5 components, Bootstrap utilities and `aui-` classes.

## Docs

- [Full reference for agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wnikk/architectui-html-theme/master/llms-full.txt): page template, frame markup, settings, JS API, themes, tokens, component classes, rules
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wnikk/architectui-html-theme/master/README.md): quick start, themes, layout options, development
- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wnikk/architectui-html-theme/master/Changelog.md): what changed in each version
- [Agent guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wnikk/architectui-html-theme/master/AGENTS.md): short how-to: files, building a page, settings, customizing, rules

## Examples

- [Live demo](https://wnikk.github.io/architectui-html-theme/): every demo page with the interface settings, themes and modes
- [Starter page](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wnikk/architectui-html-theme/master/dist/pages-starter.html): empty built page with the full frame; copy it as a starting point
- [Sign-in page](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wnikk/architectui-html-theme/master/dist/pages-login.html): built guest page without the admin frame
- [Analytics dashboard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wnikk/architectui-html-theme/master/dist/index.html): complete built dashboard
- [Operations Wall](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wnikk/architectui-html-theme/master/dist/dashboard-operations.html): dense dashboard for 1600 and 1920 px monitors with the `3xl` and `4xl` columns, one column on phones
- [Theme Palettes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wnikk/architectui-html-theme/master/dist/elements-palettes.html): every color of every theme in both modes, and how to use the colors in classes, CSS variables and scripts
- [Invoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wnikk/architectui-html-theme/master/dist/pages-invoice.html): a document page that prints on one A4 page, with a path line and a Back link above the title
- [Page sources](https://github.com/wnikk/architectui-html-theme/tree/master/src/pages): demo pages (dashboards, elements, Bootstrap components, forms and a wizard, tables, charts, calendar, maps, Kanban, inbox, invoice, profile) without the frame
- [Frame partials](https://github.com/wnikk/architectui-html-theme/tree/master/src/_includes/partials): header, sidebar, page title with the path line, footer, interface settings

## Optional

- [Theme script](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wnikk/architectui-html-theme/master/src/js/architectui.js): settings, theme switching, sidebar, search, `ArchitectUI.refresh()`, theme colors for charts
- [Guest script](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wnikk/architectui-html-theme/master/src/js/architectui-auth.js): sign in, sign up and password reset steps with a verification code, mode toggle, icons; for pages without the admin frame
- [Theme tokens](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wnikk/architectui-html-theme/master/src/scss/_tokens.scss): layout variables shared by all themes
- [Theme base](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wnikk/architectui-html-theme/master/src/scss/themes/_theme.scss): palette keys and the rules every theme shares
- [CDN addresses](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wnikk/architectui-html-theme/master/src/_data/cdn.json): exact library versions
